questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
An employer offered to pay a terminated employee $50,000 to release all claims the employee might have against the employer. The employee orally accepted the offer. The employer then prepared an unsigned release agreement and sent it to the employee for him to sign. The employee carefully prepared, signed, and sent to the employer a substitute release agreement that was identical to the original except that it excluded from the release any age discrimination claims. The employer signed the substitute release without reading it. Shortly thereafter, the employee notified the employer that he intended to sue the employer for age discrimination.
Is the employer likely to prevail in an action seeking reformation of the release to conform to the parties' oral agreement?

choices.A: No, because the employer acted unreasonably by failing to read the substitute release prior to signing it.
choices.B: No, because the parol evidence rule will preclude evidence of the oral agreement.
choices.C: Yes, because the employee's fraudulent behavior induced the employer's unilateral mistake.
choices.D: Yes, because the parties were mutually mistaken regarding the contents of the signed release.

questions.explanation:
Availability of reformation as a remedy
Misrepresentation
  • One party makes untrue assertion of fact that is fraudulent or material
  • Adversely affected party justifiably relies on that misrepresentation
Mutual mistake
  • Both parties are mistaken as to contract's contents or legal effect
Unilateral mistake
(from fraudulent misrepresentation)
  • One party is mistaken because other party intentionally misrepresented contract's content or legal effect
  • Adversely affected party justifiably relies on that misrepresentation

Reformation is an equitable remedy courts can use to rewrite a contract to reflect the parties' original intent. This remedy is always available when misrepresentation or mutual mistake occurs. But a unilateral mistake only serves as a basis for reformation if that mistake stemmed from fraudulent misrepresentation, which occurs when:

  • one party intentionally misrepresents the content or legal effect of a contract to induce the other party to enter into the contract and
  • the other party justifiably relies* on that misrepresentation.

Here, the employer reduced the parties' oral agreement to writing and sent the unsigned release to the employee. The employee then carefully prepared, signed, and sent to the employer a substitute release that omitted age discrimination claims (intentional misrepresentation). Because the substitute release was otherwise identical to the original, the employer did not notice the omission and signed the release (justifiable reliance). And since the employee's fraudulent behavior caused the employer's unilateral mistake, the court will likely reform the release to reflect the parties' oral agreement (Choice D).

*This element is always met unless the misrepresentation was patently and obviously false.

(Choice A) The employer may have acted unreasonably by failing to read the substitute release prior to signing it. But a party's negligence in failing to read a writing does not preclude reformation if the writing does not accurately reflect the parties' prior agreement.

(Choice B) The parol evidence rule generally precludes extrinsic evidence of a prior oral or written agreement to modify or contradict the unambiguous terms of a final written agreement. But such evidence is excepted from this rule and is always admissible when it is used to establish a ground for granting or denying a contractual remedy like reformation (as seen here).

📌 Educational Objective

A court can reform a contract to reflect the parties' original intent when one party's fraudulent misrepresentation caused the other party's unilateral mistake.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 166 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (reformation based on fraudulent misrepresentation).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 172 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (definition of justifiable reliance).
questions.zh-question:
某雇主提出向一名被解雇的员工支付 50,000 美元，以了结该员工可能对雇主提出的所有索赔。该员工口头接受了该提议。随后，雇主准备了一份未签署的免责协议，并将其发送给该员工签署。该员工精心准备、签署并向雇主发送了一份替代免责协议，该协议除排除了任何年龄歧视索赔外，与原协议完全相同。雇主未阅读该替代免责协议就签署了。此后不久，该员工通知雇主，他打算以年龄歧视为由起诉雇主。

在寻求对免责协议进行修正（reformation）以使其符合双方口头协议的诉讼中，雇主是否可能胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为雇主在签署替代免责协议前未予阅读，其行为不合理。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为口头证据规则（parol evidence rule）将排除有关口头协议的证据。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为员工的欺诈行为导致了雇主的单方错误（unilateral mistake）。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为双方对已签署的免责协议内容存在共同错误（mutual mistake）。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Remedies - Defenses To Formation

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：一方用虚假修改（fraudulent misrepresentation）诱发对方对书面协议内容的单方错误（unilateral mistake）时，法院能不能用衡平法上的更正（reformation）把合同改回双方原本口头约定。

三秒认题路径：

口头同意 → 送来书面稿 → 对方偷偷改掉 → 你误签 → 可更正

核心法律规则

更正（reformation）是法院用来把书面合同改回双方原意的衡平救济。若错误来自虚假陈述（misrepresentation），只要受害方合理信赖（justifiable reliance），法院通常可以更正。

如果只是双方都看错了内容或法律效果，那是共同错误（mutual mistake）。但本题关键不是“谁没细读”，而是“是谁故意把内容改掉骗对方签字”。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 166 说明：当一方的欺诈性失实陈述导致对方单方错误时，可以据此更正合同。

思维导图

先看：书面 release 和口头协议不一致，是不是因为一方故意改了内容？
是：员工把原本的 release 改成 排除 age discrimination claims，这是故意失实陈述。
再看：雇主是否因该改动而误签？
雇主没读就签，但仍属对改动内容的合理信赖；“没细读”不自动挡住更正。
结论：属于欺诈诱发的单方错误，可把 release 改回双方原来口头同意的版本。
否：如果只是双方一起看错，才会往共同错误（mutual mistake）方向走。
答案：C

考点陷阱

你可能会想：雇主签字前没读，自己太粗心，所以不能救。

但考试真正问的是：员工有没有故意把 release 改掉，导致雇主签在错误版本上。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

所以这里的焦点不是雇主是否尽责，而是员工的欺骗是否让雇主对书面内容产生了可救济的单方错误。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

员工把 release 悄悄改成排除 age discrimination claims，雇主据此误签，正是欺诈诱发的单方错误，所以法院可更正回原口头协议。

❌ 事实误判 | 读稿细节偷换

✕ A: 把failed to read当成致命点了。

❌ 法律适用 | 证据规则搬错

✕ B: 用parol evidence挡更正证据，方向错了。

❌ 概念混淆 | 单双错误混认

✕ D: 把单方被骗写成双方都看错，偷换成mutual mistake。

这题建议用什么方法？

先找有没有欺骗改稿，再看误签是不是因此发生；“没读”只管粗心，不管能否更正。

考场速记

记住：欺诈导致单方错误，更正通常能成；只是没仔细读，一般救不了对方故意改稿的骗局。

下次看到“口头协议 + 对方改了书面版 + 你误签”，先想更正，不要先被“没读”带跑。

question_analysis.skill_tested: determining availability of contract reformation remedy

reason.en: Shows the parties originally formed an agreement before reducing it to writing.
reason.zh: 表明双方在将其转化为书面形式之前已达成一致协议。

reason.en: The document containing the unauthorized unilateral change by the employee.
reason.zh: 包含雇员单方面未经授权修改的文件。

reason.en: Focuses on the negligent behavior of the signing party which is often mistaken as a bar to reformation.

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question: An art collector paid a gallery $1,000 to purchase a framed drawing from the gallery's collection. The price included shipping by the gallery to the collector's home. The gallery's owner used inadequate materials to wrap the drawing. The frame broke during shipment and scratched the drawing, reducing the drawing's value to $300. The collector complained to the gallery owner, who told the collector to take the drawing to a specific art restorer to have the drawing repaired. The collector paid the restorer $400 to repair the drawing, but not all of the scratches could be fixed. The drawing, after being repaired, was worth $700. The gallery owner subsequently refused to pay either for the repairs or for the damage to the drawing. In an action by the collector against the gallery owner for damages, which of the following awards is most likely?

choices.A: Nothing.

questions.explanation:
UCC effect of repair costs on buyer's recovery
Effect of buyer's repairs
Buyer's recovery
Seller breaches by damaging goods
Restores goods to warranted value
Paid repair costs
Does not restore goods to warranted value
Paid repair costs +
(warranted − post-repair value)
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

Under the UCC, contracts for the sale of goods come with an implied warranty of merchantability if the seller is a merchant with respect to the type of goods involved. Under this warranty, damage caused by the seller's failure to adequately package an item constitutes a breach. If the buyer nevertheless chooses to accept the goods, the buyer's damages are the difference between:

  • the value of the goods as accepted and
  • the value of the goods as warranted.

Repair costs are often used to determine this difference in value. But if the repairs fail to restore the goods to their value as warranted, the buyer can recover the repair costs plus the difference between the value of the goods as warranted and the value of the goods after the repairs.*

Here, the gallery's use of inadequate materials to wrap the drawing constituted a breach of warranty. The resulting damage during shipment reduced the drawing's value to $300. And although the art collector paid the restorer $400 to repair the drawing, it was worth just $700 after the repairs. As a result, the collector can recover the repair costs ($400) plus the difference between the drawing's value after the repairs and its value as warranted ($1,000 - $700 = $300). Therefore, an award of $700 is most likely (Choices A, B & C).

*This assumes that the buyer paid for the repairs.

📌 Educational Objective

When repairs fail to restore goods to their value as warranted, the buyer's damages are equal to the cost of repairs plus the difference between the value of the goods after the repairs and the value of the goods as warranted.

📚 References
  • U.C.C. § 2-314 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (implied warranty of merchantability).
  • U.C.C. § 2-714 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (buyer's damages for breach in regard to accepted goods).

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Remedies - Remedies Under the UCC

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：《统一商法典》（UCC）下，卖方交货已构成违约后，如果买家自己修了货，但修复后还是没回到约定价值（warranted value），买家能拿回多少损害赔偿。

三秒认题路径：

卖方包装不当 → 货物受损 → 买家接受并修理 → 修后未复原 → 赔修理费 + 差额

核心法律规则

在货物买卖（sale of goods）里，商人卖家通常附有适销性默示担保（implied warranty of merchantability）；包装不当（improper packaging）把货弄坏，就是违约。买方接受货物（accept goods）后，损害赔偿看的是value as accepted 和 value as warranted 的差额。若修理后仍没恢复到原本担保价值，买家可以要回修理费（repair costs），再加上“担保价值 - 修后价值”的那一段。

核心判例： U.C.C. § 2-314、U.C.C. § 2-714 —— 锁定本题：修理没修回去时，赔偿不是只看修理费，而是“修理费 + 价值差额”。

思维导图

1. 先看卖方有没有违约？
有。 这里是商人卖货，且用不合格材料包装，导致画作运输中受损，已经触发担保违约。
2. 买家是拒收，还是接受后再修？
接受后再修。 这时不是“退货拿全额货款”的路线，而是走 accepted goods 的损害赔偿公式。
3. 修理有没有把货修回担保价值？
没有。 修后只值 $700，而担保价值是 $1,000，说明修理只补了一部分。
卡死点：修后仍有 $300 的价值差额，不能只给修理费。
4. 所以赔多少？
$400 + $300 = $700。 先赔实际修理费，再补上没修回来的价值差额，答案选 D。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然已经修了，而且货还能用，那就只赔repair costs $400。

但考试真正问的是：修完之后有没有回到原本应有的价值；这里没有回满，所以还要把没补上的价值差额（difference in value）算进去。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干 修理后只值 $700，说明修复没有回到担保价值；所以应赔 $400 修理费 + $300 价值差额，合计 $700。

❌ 概念混淆 | 只看退货

✕ A: 把接受后损害赔偿错看成“没救济”。

❌ 事实误判 | 只认修理费

✕ B: 只盯 paid repair costs，漏掉修后没修回来的 $300。

❌ 法律适用 | 金额算少了

✕ C: 只算 repair costs，没把差额补上。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看修理是否真的修回担保价值；没修回，就直接套“修理费 + 未恢复价值差额”。

考场速记

记住一句：修好了但没修满，就不是只赔修理费，而是修理费 + 还没补回来的价值差额。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A lumber mill contracted with a trucking company to transport lumber from the mill to a residential contractor. The trucking company promised the mill that the lumber would arrive at the location specified in the contract on August 1. However, the contract contained a clause providing that the trucking company would not be liable for any losses suffered by the mill as a result of a late shipment. The trucking company was aware that the mill had contracted with the contractor to deliver the lumber on August 1, and that the price to be paid by the contractor decreased for each day that the lumber was late. The shipment of lumber did not reach the contractor until August 10, and the trucking company had no justification for the delay. Because of the delay, the mill lost revenue from the sale in excess of the cost to transport the lumber to the contractor. The mill filed suit against the trucking company for breach of contract, claiming damages based on its lost revenue.
Is the mill likely to succeed in its claim for these damages?

choices.A: No, because the claimed damages exceeded the original contract price between the trucking company and mill to transport the lumber.
choices.B: No, because the contract between the mill and the trucking company protected the company from losses suffered by the mill due to a late shipment.
choices.C: Yes, because consequential damages cannot be excluded by a merchant.
choices.D: Yes, because the damages that the mill would suffer from the trucking company's delay were known to the company before shipment of the lumber.

questions.explanation:
Consequential damages

Damages for losses stemming from nonbreaching party's special circumstances if breaching party:

  • • knew of those special circumstances
OR
  • • could have reasonably foreseen harm caused by breach

The primary goal of contract damages is to put the nonbreaching party in the same position it would have been in had the contract been fully performed. This includes recovering consequential damages for losses arising from the nonbreaching party's special circumstances if the breaching party:

  • • knew about those circumstances or
  • • could have reasonably foreseen the harm that would result from a breach.

However, contracting parties are free to set their own terms, so they can agree to limit or exclude the recovery of consequential damages (unless the limitation or exclusion is unconscionable).

Here, the trucking company agreed to deliver the lumber from the mill to the contractor. The trucking company knew that the mill entered into a contract with the contractor to deliver the lumber on August 1 and that the mill would suffer damages if the delivery was delayed. Nevertheless, the lumber was not delivered until August 10 (Choice D). But because the contract included a clause that the trucking company would not be liable for losses suffered by the mill as a result of a late shipment, the mill is unlikely to succeed in its claim for damages.

(Choice A) The lack of proportionality between the contract price and the amount of consequential damages may be an underlying factor in determining whether such damages are foreseeable. But proportionality alone is not determinative regarding foreseeability. In any case, the parties may generally allocate responsibility for consequential damages as they see fit.

(Choice C) The UCC prohibits the limitation or exclusion of liability for consequential damages, but only if the limitation or exclusion is unconscionable. A commercial loss (e.g., lost revenue) is not prima facie unconscionable. Additionally, the UCC applies only to contracts for the sale of goods (not this service contract).

📌 Educational Objective

Parties to a contract are free to set their own terms—including limiting or excluding the recovery of consequential damages.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 351, Reporter's Note to cmt. a (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (discussing enforceability of agreements to exclude or limit consequential damages).

主题：合同法（Contracts）— 救济（Remedies）

题目：
一家 lumber mill（木材厂）与一家 trucking company（卡车运输公司）订立合同，由该公司将木材从木材厂运送给一位 residential contractor（住宅承包商）。运输公司向木材厂承诺，木材将在合同指定地点于8月1日送达。然而，合同中包含一项条款，规定对于因迟延发货而使木材厂遭受的任何损失，运输公司不承担责任。运输公司知道木材厂已经与该承包商签订合同，约定于8月1日交付木材，并且承包商应支付的价款会因木材迟延送达的每一天而减少。木材直到8月10日才送达承包商处，而且运输公司的迟延没有任何正当理由。由于这次迟延，木材厂因该笔销售而损失的收入，超过了将木材运送给承包商的成本。木材厂以 breach of contract（违约）为由起诉运输公司，主张基于其 lost revenue（损失收入）的 damages（损害赔偿）。

木材厂是否有可能在该项损害赔偿请求中胜诉？

zh-choices.A: 不能，因为所主张的损害赔偿超过了木材厂与运输公司之间原始运输合同的价款。
zh-choices.B: 不能，因为木材厂与运输公司之间的合同使该公司免于承担因迟延发货而使木材厂遭受的损失。
zh-choices.C: 可以，因为 consequential damages（间接损害赔偿）不能被 merchant（商人）排除。
zh-choices.D: 可以，因为运输公司在木材发货前已经知道，如果其迟延，木材厂将遭受该等损害。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Remedies - Remedies

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：合同一方能否用 限制或排除条款（limitation/exclusion clause） 拦住对方主张 后果性损害（consequential damages）。

三秒认题路径：

先看损害类型 → 再看有无排除条款 → 再看条款是否无效 → 直接选能不能赔

核心法律规则

合同损害赔偿的目标，是把守约方放回到如果合同被履行时应有的位置；所以，后果性损害（consequential damages） 在对方知道特殊情况、或能合理预见损害时，通常可以要。

但考试更爱考另一句：当事人可以自己约定 限制或排除后果性损害（limit or exclude consequential damages），只要这个约定不 显失公平（unconscionable）。

所以本题不是在问“能不能预见”，而是在问“合同里已经写了不赔晚到造成的损失，学生还能不能硬把这笔钱要回来”。答案通常是不能。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 351 的思路是：可预见性只是默认规则，但当事人可以用条款把后果性损害关掉。

思维导图

题干先给你什么？
1. 先看到 晚到造成的损失（loss from late shipment），这类钱看起来像 后果性损害（consequential damages）。
2. 再看合同有没有写 不负责晚到损失（not liable for losses due to late shipment）。
卡死点：一旦条款有效，foreseeable 也没用，先前知道风险不等于一定能拿赔偿。
3. 题干没给 显失公平（unconscionable），也不是典型的 UCC 售货合同，所以排除 C。
4. 结论：有排除条款 + 不是无效条款 = 不能靠后果性损害赢，所以选 B。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然托运公司早就知道会晚到、也知道对方会亏钱，那是不是就一定要赔 lost revenue。

但考试真正问的是：合同已经把这类 后果性损害（consequential damages） 排除了，你还能不能绕过条款直接索赔。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的损失看起来有多真实」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干已有 不承担晚到损失 的条款，所以即使有可预见性，后果性损害 也被合同先行拦住，原告难赢。

❌ 事实误判 | 价格比例误读

✕ A: 把 contract price 当成赔偿上限，题干根本没这条规则。

❌ 法律适用 | UCC 场景错套

✕ C: 先把 merchant 扣上去，但本题是服务运输，不是售货合同。

❌ 概念混淆 | 可预见性偷换

✕ D: 只盯着 known to the company，却漏了合同已经把这类损失排除掉。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看损害类型，再看合同有没有把这类钱直接关掉。

考场速记

记住一句：可预见 只是默认能赔的入口，排除条款 才是本题的终点；合同先写“不赔”，通常就先按合同走。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A man who knew nothing about horses inherited a thoroughbred colt whose disagreeable behavior made him a pest around the barn. The man sold the horse for $1,500 to a buyer who was an experienced racehorse-trainer and knew of the man's ignorance about horses. At the time of sale, the man said to the buyer, "I hate to say it, but this horse is bad-tempered and nothing special."
Which one of the following scenarios would best support an action by the buyer to rescind the sale?

choices.A: A week after the sale, the horse went berserk and inflicted injuries upon the buyer that required his hospitalization for six months and a full year for his recovery.
choices.B: After the horse had won three races for the buyer, it was discovered that by clerical error, unknown to either party, the horse's official birth registration listed an undistinguished racehorse as the sire rather than the famous racehorse that in fact was the sire.
choices.C: In his first race after the sale, the horse galloped to a huge lead but dropped dead 100 yards from the finish line because of a rare congenital heart defect that was undiscoverable except by autopsy.
choices.D: The horse won $5 million for the buyer over a three-year racing career but upon being retired was found to be incurably sterile and useless as a breeder.

questions.explanation:
Mistake as grounds for rescission
Mutual
mistake
Adversely affected party can rescind contract if:
  • mistake relates to basic assumption of contract
  • mistake materially affects agreed-upon exchange of performances
AND
  • adversely affected party did not assume risk of mistake
Unilateral
mistake
In addition to above elements for mutual mistake, either:
  • mistake makes enforcement of contract unconscionable
OR
  • nonmistaken party caused, or knew or should have known of, mistake

When both parties enter into a contract based on the same mistake (i.e., mutual mistake), the adversely affected party can rescind (i.e., cancel) the contract if:

  • the mistake relates to a basic assumption of the contract
  • the mistake materially affects the agreed-upon exchange of performances (i.e., the adversely affected party cannot fairly be required to carry it out) and
  • the adversely affected party did not assume the risk of the mistake.

Here, the parties most likely entered the contract based on an erroneous belief that the horse was healthy and fit to race—a basic assumption of the contract. That mutual mistake materially affected the agreed-upon exchange since the horse actually had been born with a rare congenital heart defect. And since that defect was undiscoverable except by autopsy, the buyer did not assume the risk that the horse would turn out to be unhealthy and unfit to race. As a result, the buyer can likely rescind the sale.

(Choice A) The grounds for rescission must have existed when the contract was made. Because the horse went berserk a week after the sale, the buyer cannot seek rescission on this basis.

(Choice B) Although both parties were mistaken as to the colt's true sire (a famous racehorse), the buyer would not be able to rescind the contract on this basis since the mistake made the colt more valuable to the buyer.

(Choice D) Because the horse (which was sold for a mere $1,500) won $5 million for the buyer over three years, the buyer cannot successfully claim that it would be unfair to enforce the sale (i.e., no material effect).

📌 Educational Objective

Rescission is available due to a mutual mistake if (1) the mistake relates to a basic assumption of the contract, (2) the mistake materially affects the agreed-upon exchange of performances, and (3) the adversely affected party did not assume the risk of the mistake.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 152 cmt. c (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (material effect of mutual mistake making contract voidable).

一个对马一无所知的男子继承了一匹纯种小马，这匹马脾气不好，在马厩里是个麻烦精。该男子以1500美元的价格将马卖给了一位买家，这位买家是一位经验丰富的赛马训练师，并且知道该男子对马一无所知。在出售时，该男子对买家说：“我不想这么说，但这匹马脾气不好，没什么特别之处。”

下列哪种情况最能支持买家提起诉讼以撤销该交易？

zh-choices.A: 交易一周后，该马匹发狂并致使买家受伤，买家因此需要住院六个月，并用一整年时间进行康复。
zh-choices.B: 在该马匹为买家赢得三场比赛后，人们发现，由于双方都不知晓的一处文书错误，该马匹的官方出生登记将其父亲列为一匹无名赛马，而非其实际上的父亲——一匹著名赛马。
zh-choices.C: 在交易后的第一场比赛中，该马匹曾一度遥遥领先，但在距离终点线100码处因一种罕见的先天性心脏缺陷而猝死，该缺陷除非通过尸检否则无法发现。
zh-choices.D: 在三年的赛马生涯中，该马匹为买家赢得了500万美元奖金，但在退役时被发现患有不治之症的不育症，作为种马毫无价值。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Remedies - Defenses To Formation

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：双方在签约时对马的健康状况有共同错误时，买方能不能以 互相错误（mutual mistake） 撤销合同。

三秒认题路径：

签约当时就错 → 基本假设错 → 交换受重创 → 未承担风险 → 可撤销

核心法律规则

撤销的门槛不是“事后变差”，而是“签约时就错”

如果双方对同一事实都弄错，而且这个错误关系到合同的基本假设，互相错误（mutual mistake） 下，受害方可以撤销合同。这里的 materially affects the agreed-upon exchange 考场意思：这个错让合同交换失衡到不该强迫当事人继续履行。

但受害方还必须没有 assume the risk，考场意思：如果他自己把风险接过去了，就不能事后反悔。题目还要求错误必须存在于订约时，所以事后才发生的坏事不算。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 152 cmt. c —— 互相错误只在“基本假设 + 实质影响 + 未承担风险”都满足时，才支持撤销。

思维导图

先看错的是不是在订约时（at the time of contract formation）就存在？
YES买方和卖方都以为马能健康参赛 → 这是合同的基本假设（basic assumption）。
YES后来发现马天生有罕见心脏缺陷，而且只能尸检发现 → 错误直接打穿交换价值。
CHECK买方有没有承担这个风险？没有，因为缺陷根本无法正常发现。
kill：effectively reviewable 不是这里的判断点；本题只看能否撤销，答案锁定为 C。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：马后来发狂、血统搞错、或比赛赚了很多钱，都像是“有问题”，所以都能撤销。

但考试真正问的是：司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。 这题只认签约时的共同错误；事后受伤、血统更值钱、或后面赚大钱，都不是撤销的核心。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干 rare congenital heart defect 说明双方订约时都错认马健康，且该缺陷只靠尸检才发现，正好满足互相错误撤销。

❌ 事实误判 | 事后伤害误认

✕ A: 把a week after当成订约时的错误了。

❌ 概念混淆 | 更有价值误判

✕ B: 把血统误认当成可撤销理由，却忽略它反而让马更值钱。

❌ 法律适用 | 材料影响误判

✕ D: 后来赚了$5 million，就说明错误没实质影响。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓订约时是否已错，再看是否打到合同基本假设，最后确认有没有承担风险。

考场速记

记住一句：互相错误（mutual mistake） 不是“后来出了问题”，而是“签的时候就错了，还错到交换失衡”。

好记法：先看时点，再看假设，最后看风险。

reason.en: Identifies the specific legal remedy sought by the buyer.
reason.zh: 确定买方所寻求的特定法律救济。

reason.zh: 对买方实际上有利的误解不满足受不利影响这一要件。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A produce distributor contracted to provide a grocer with eight crates of lettuce at the distributor's listed price. The distributor's shipping clerk mistakenly shipped only seven crates to the grocer. The grocer accepted delivery of the seven crates but immediately notified the distributor that the delivery did not conform to the contract. The distributor's listed price for seven crates of lettuce was 7/8 of its listed price for eight crates. The distributor shipped no more lettuce to the grocer, and the grocer has not yet paid for any of the lettuce.
How much, if anything, is the distributor entitled to collect from the grocer?

choices.A: Nothing, because the tender of all eight crates was a condition precedent to the grocer's duty to pay.
choices.B: The listed price for the seven crates of lettuce.
choices.C: The listed price for the seven crates of lettuce, minus the grocer's damages, if any, for the distributor's failure to deliver the full order.
choices.D: The reasonable value of the seven crates of lettuce, minus the grocer's damages, if any, for the distributor's failure to deliver the full order.

questions.explanation:
Buyer's rights on improper delivery (UCC § 2-601)
Did seller provide goods that conform
perfectly to contract?
Yes ➜ No breach
No
Breach of contract
Buyer may:
Accept goods in
whole or part
Reject goods in
whole or part
  • Buyer must pay for accepted goods minus any damages
  • Seller can cure breach by tendering conforming goods if time remains to perform

The Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) governs contracts for the sale of goods (eg, lettuce). Under the UCC, goods must conform perfectly to the contract. Failure to provide such goods is a breach that, unless cured in the time remaining to perform, allows the buyer to reject or accept the goods in whole or in part. When the buyer accepts the goods, the buyer must pay the seller the contract price of the accepted goods minus any damages incurred as a result of the breach—eg, damages incurred to cover (ie, purchase) substitute goods.

Here, the distributor contracted to provide the grocer with eight crates of lettuce. The distributor then mistakenly shipped only seven crates of lettuce and did not cure this defect (breach). The grocer accepted the seven crates, so the distributor is entitled to collect the listed contract price (not the reasonable value) for those crates (Choice D). However, that price must be reduced by the grocer's damages, if any, resulting from the distributor's breach (Choice B).

(Choice A) The tender of all eight crates was not a condition precedent to the grocer's duty to pay. That is because the grocer had the option to accept or reject the nonconforming goods. But since the grocer accepted seven crates of lettuce, it must pay for those seven crates minus any damages incurred.

📌 Educational Objective

If goods do not conform perfectly to the contract, it is a breach under the UCC. The UCC allows the buyer to reject or accept the goods in whole or in part. When the buyer accepts the goods, the buyer must pay the seller the contract price of the accepted goods minus any damages incurred as a result of the breach.

📚 References
  • U.C.C. § 2-601 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (buyer's rights on improper delivery).
  • U.C.C. § 2-717 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (buyer may deduct damages from price due).
questions.zh-question:
一家农产品分销商签约，按其标价向一家杂货商提供八箱生菜。该分销商的发货员错误地只向杂货商运送了七箱。杂货商接受了这七箱货物的交付，但立即通知分销商，该交付不符合合同规定。分销商对七箱生菜的标价是其八箱生菜标价的7/8。分销商没有再向杂货商运送生菜，而杂货商也尚未支付任何生菜的款项。

分销商有权向杂货商收取多少款项（如有）？

zh-choices.A: 无权收取任何款项，因为交付全部八箱货物是杂货商付款义务的先决条件。
zh-choices.B: 七箱生菜的标价。
zh-choices.C: 七箱生菜的标价，减去因分销商未能完全交付订单而给杂货商造成的损失（如有）。
zh-choices.D: 七箱生菜的合理价值，减去因分销商未能完全交付订单而给杂货商造成的损失（如有）。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Remedies - Expectation interest

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：买卖合同下，卖方部分交货被买方接受后，卖方能按合同价收取已接受部分，但要扣掉买方因少交货产生的损失。

三秒认题路径：

货物买卖 → 少交一箱 → 买方收货 → 卖方按价收已收部分 → 扣买方损失

核心法律规则

这题用的是商品买卖下的 完美交付规则（perfect tender rule）：货物不符合合同，买方可以拒收，也可以收下全部或一部分。接受（acceptance） 的意思是：买方既然留下货，就要按合同价（contract price）付已接受部分，而不是改按合理价值算。

但买方可以把因卖方违约造成的损失，从价款里扣掉，这就是 抵扣损失（deduct damages from price due）。所以卖方不是“收不到钱”，而是“按已收部分的合同价收钱，再被买方的损失往下减”。

核心判例： 这里不靠判例名取胜，直接按 UCC § 2-601 和 § 2-717 走：不完全交货是违约；买方收下七箱后，卖方能收七箱合同价，但要扣买方损失。

思维导图

先看：卖方有没有按合同“完美交货”？
YES 没违约，按合同直接结算。
NO 少送一箱 = 违约。
再看 买方怎么处理？
拒收 → 卖方很难拿到价款。
接受七箱 → 卖方可收 七箱合同价，不是合理价值。
最后卡死点：要再扣买方因少交货产生的损失。
结论：选 C

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然只送了七箱，卖方是不是只能按“实际交付的合理价值”收钱，甚至因为没送满八箱就一分钱都拿不到。

但考试真正问的是：买方已经接受七箱，就说明他不是在“全盘拒收”，而是在接受后再算价款和损失。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的货有没有少一箱」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干 买方已接受七箱，所以卖方按七箱合同价（contract price）收款，但要扣掉买方因少送一箱的损失。

❌ 概念混淆 | 条件前置误判

✕ A: 把condition precedent想成必须全送满才付款，忽略了买方已接受部分货物。

❌ 事实误判 | 忽略损失抵扣

✕ B: 只看到七箱被收下，就忘了价款还要扣掉买方因少交货产生的损失。

❌ 法律适用 | 合理价值套错

✕ D: 把reasonable value搬来，但 UCC 这里看的是合同价，不是普通不当得利算法。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓“是否接受部分货物”，再立刻切到“按合同价结算并抵扣损失”，不要被少交货的故事感带跑。

考场速记

记住一句：不完全交货先看买方收不收；收了，就按已接受部分的合同价付，再扣损失。看到商品买卖题，先问“拒收还是接受”，别先算合理价值。

question_analysis.skill_tested: calculating seller recovery after buyer acceptance

reason.en: Establishes the existence of a binding agreement between the parties.
reason.zh: 确立双方之间存在具有约束力的协议。

reason.en: Constitutes a breach of the perfect tender rule by the seller.
reason.zh: 构成卖方违反完美交付规则的行为。

reason.en: Triggers the buyer's obligation to pay at the contract rate under the UCC.
reason.zh: 触发买方在UCC下按合同价格付款的义务。

reason.en: Preserves the buyer's right to seek damages for the nonconforming delivery.
reason.zh: 保留买方因非违约交付而索赔的权利。

reason.en: Indicates that the seller's action is for the price of the accepted goods.
reason.zh: 表明卖方的诉求是要求支付已接受货物的价款。

reason.en: Misapplies the perfect tender rule to bar any recovery after acceptance.
reason.zh: 错误地将完美交付视为接受货物后付款的绝对先决条件。

reason.en: Fails to account for the buyer's right to deduct damages for breach.
reason.zh: 未能考虑买方扣除违约损失的权利。

reason.en: Correctly applies UCC 2-717 allowing the buyer to deduct damages from the price.

reason.en: Incorrectly uses quasi-contractual recovery instead of the contract rate for accepted goods.
reason.zh: 错误地使用准合同恢复，而非针对已接受货物的合同价格。

highlights.text: accepted delivery of the seven crates

reason.en: Under UCC 2-607, acceptance obligates the buyer to pay the contract rate for those goods.
reason.zh: 根据UCC 2-607，接受货物使买方有义务为该货物支付合同价。

reason.en: Timely notice is required under UCC 2-607(3)(a) to preserve breach remedies including damages.
reason.zh: 根据UCC 2-607(3)(a)，必须及时通知以保留包括损失赔偿在内的违约救济。

highlights.text: mistakenly shipped only seven crates

reason.en: Establishes that the seller breached the contract by failing to deliver the full quantity.
reason.zh: 确立卖方因未能交付全部数量而违反合同。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A seller and a farmer formed a written, signed contract for the sale of a 500-acre tract of farmland. The contract provided for exchange of the deed for $500,000 in cash on January 15. On January 15, the seller notified the farmer that because the tenant currently residing on the farmland wrongfully refused to quit the premises, the seller could not deliver possession until January 30. On January 30, the farmer accepted the conveyance, paid the $500,000, and took possession of the farmland while reserving his rights to any damages caused by the seller's breach.
The farmer had purchased 500 head of cattle to be delivered to the farmland on January 15. Because he did not have possession of the farmland on that date, he had to rent another pasture for $2,000 to graze the cattle for 15 days. The seller had no reason to know the farmer purchased cattle or planned to graze them on the farmland. Throughout January, the farmland's market value was $510,000 and its fair monthly rental value was $5,000.
In an action by the farmer against the seller for damages, what is the farmer entitled to recover?

choices.A: $2,500 only (the fair rental value of the farmland for 15 days).
choices.B: $2,500 (the fair rental value of the farmland for 15 days), plus $2,000 (the cost of grazing the cattle elsewhere for 15 days).
choices.C: Nominal damages only, because the market value of the land exceeded the contract price.
choices.D: Nothing, because by paying the purchase price on January 30, he waived whatever cause of action he may have had.

questions.explanation:
Alternative bases for recovery when loss in value uncertain
Delayed use of property
  • Fair rental value of property during period of delay
OR
  • Interest on value of property made unproductive by breach
Defective or unfinished construction
  • Diminution in market price of property caused by breach
OR
  • Reasonable cost of completing performance or remedying defects

A nonbreaching party's recovery is typically based on the loss in value to that party caused by the breach. But if the loss in value cannot be proved with reasonable certainty and there is a reasonable alternative to loss in value, the nonbreaching party may claim damages based on that alternative. For example, if a breach delays the use of property, the nonbreaching party may recover damages based on:

  • the fair rental value of the property during the period of the delay or
  • interest on the value of the property that has been made unproductive by the breach.

Here, the seller breached the land-sale contract by failing to deliver possession of the farmland on January 15 as agreed. On January 30, the farmer accepted the conveyance, paid the purchase price, and took possession of the farmland while reserving his right to sue for any damages caused by the seller's breach (Choice D). As a result, the farmer is entitled to recover $2,500—the fair rental value of the farmland for the 15-day period during which he was denied possession.

However, the farmer is not entitled to recover $2,000 for the cost of grazing the cattle elsewhere for 15 days (Choice B). The reason is that consequential damages arising from the nonbreaching party's special circumstances are only recoverable if the breaching party (1) knew about the special circumstances or (2) could have reasonably foreseen the harm, in light of those circumstances, that would result from the breach. Here, the seller had no reason to know that the farmer had purchased cattle or planned to graze them on the farmland.

(Choice C) The fact that the market value of the farmland ($510,000) exceeded the contract price ($500,000) does not limit the farmer's recovery to nominal damages only.

📌 Educational Objective

If a breach delays the use of property, the nonbreaching party may recover damages based on (1) the fair rental value of the property during the delay period or (2) interest on the value of the property made unproductive by the breach.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 348 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (alternatives to loss in value of performance).
questions.zh-question:
一名卖方和一名农场主签订了一份书面合同，出售一块500英亩的农田。合同规定，于1月15日以500,000美元现金交换地契。1月15日，卖方通知农场主，由于目前居住在农田上的租户无理拒绝搬离，卖方要到1月30日才能交付占有权。1月30日，农场主接受了产权转让，支付了500,000美元，并占有了该农田，同时保留了就卖方违约造成的任何损害索赔的权利。

该农场主购买了500头牛，原定于1月15日运至该农田。由于当日他未能占有该农田，他不得不另租一处牧场15天，花费2,000美元来放牧这些牛。卖方没有理由知道农场主购买了牛或计划在该农田上放牧。整个1月份，该农田的市场价值为510,000美元，其公平月租金价值为5,000美元。

在农场主对卖方提起的损害赔偿诉讼中，农场主有权获得多少赔偿？

zh-choices.A: 仅2,500美元（该农田15天的公平租金价值）。
zh-choices.B: 2,500美元（该农田15天的公平租金价值），加上2,000美元（在别处放牧牛15天的费用）。
zh-choices.C: 仅象征性损害赔偿，因为土地的市场价值超过了合同价格。
zh-choices.D: 无权获得任何赔偿，因为他在1月30日支付了购买价款，从而放弃了他可能拥有的任何诉因。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Remedies - Expectation interest

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：卖方延迟交付占有时，买方能否按 合理租金（fair rental value） 主张期待利益，而不是把自己另外养牛的损失也一起算进去。

三秒认题路径：

延期交付 → 先看租金 → 再看可预见性 → 只赔可救济部分 → 选 A

核心法律规则

这题只抓一个规则

合同被违约后，如果是 财产使用被延迟（delayed use of property），损失价值不好精确证明时，考场上常改看替代指标：延期期间的合理租金（fair rental value），或者被违约“冻住”的财产价值所生的利息。

后果性损害（consequential damages） 只有在卖方知道你的特殊用途，或本来就能合理预见时才赔；卖方不知道你买牛来放牧，就不用替你承担外部牧场费用。

所以这题的可赔范围，是“土地晚给我 15 天”的一般使用损失，不是“我自己养牛计划被打乱”的特殊损失。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 348 的思路就是：使用被延迟时，可用租金或利息当替代基准，锁定本题只能拿一般使用损失。

思维导图

卖方没按 1 月 15 日交付占有，先看这是不是“延期使用财产”
是 进入替代赔偿：合理租金（fair rental value） 或利息
本题事实 15 天不能用农场 → 合理租金 = $5,000 / 月，折算 15 天约 $2,500
卡死点：effectively reviewable 不适用；这里也不是“特殊损失全包”，而是只赔可预见的一般使用损失
额外牛群费用 卖方不知道买牛和放牧计划 → consequential damages 断掉
结果 只到 A：$2,500

考点陷阱

你可能会想：农场晚交 15 天，买牛的人还得另租牧场，$2,000 也该一起赔。

但考试真正问的是：这笔钱是不是卖方能预见的后果性损害；这里卖方根本不知道你买了牛、还准备在这块地上放牧。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干的关键触发点是 1 月 15 日没给占有、1 月 30 日才交付，所以先赔 15 天的合理租金；按每月 $5,000 折算，正好是 $2,500。

❌ 事实误判 | 偷换特殊损失

✕ B: 把额外牧场费当成卖方该预见的支出。

❌ 法律适用 | 误用市价规则

✕ C: 看到 market value 就想压成名义赔偿，但这里赔的是延迟使用，不是物价差。

❌ 概念混淆 | 误认弃权

✕ D: 1 月 30 日付款取房不等于放弃索赔，题干明说他保留了损害赔偿权利。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓程序姿态：延期交付先算一般使用损失，再单独筛掉不可预见的特殊损失。

考场速记

记住这句：延期占有 → 先看合理租金；特殊用途损失 → 先问卖方知不知道。如果题目在问中间上诉，再背：In Certain Circumstances, An Appeal Can Be Made Prematurely，通常对应 injunction、certification、class action 等法定例外；但本题不是上诉题，是典型的期待利益赔偿题。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A firm contracted with a municipality to repair a drawbridge and began work on February 1. The contract provided that the firm would be paid an additional $1,000 for each day the repair was completed before the April 1 completion deadline. On March 14, an unusual gear on the bridge broke. On that same day, the firm contracted with a supplier for a March 15 delivery to the bridge site of the only available replacement gear. The supplier did not know the firm's contract contained an incentive-pay provision regarding early completion. The supplier misdirected the delivery of the gear, and the firm did not receive it until March 20. The work on the bridge was completed on March 21. Had it not been for the late delivery of the gear, however, the firm would have completed the bridge repair on March 16.
In an action against the supplier for breach of contract, will the firm be permitted to recover, as part of its damages, the additional $5,000 early-completion incentive pay it would have received from the municipality but for the supplier's breach?

choices.A: No, because the supplier did not expressly agree to be responsible for such damages.
choices.B: No, because the supplier did not know and had no reason to know about the incentive-pay provision regarding early completion.
choices.C: Yes, because, by the nature of its contract with the firm, the supplier should have known that time was of the essence.
choices.D: Yes, because the supplier is liable for all damages flowing directly from its breach.

questions.explanation:
Consequential damages

Damages for losses stemming from nonbreaching party's special circumstances if breaching party:

  • knew of those special circumstances
OR
  • could have reasonably foreseen harm caused by breach

After a contract is breached, the nonbreaching party may seek compensatory damages. Generally, these damages aim to put the nonbreaching party in the same position as if the contract had been performed. As a result, the calculation begins by determining expectation damages—i.e., the natural and obvious losses from the breach. And in some cases, consequential damages—i.e., losses arising from a party's special circumstances—are also warranted. Consequential damages are appropriate only if the breaching party:

  • knew about the nonbreaching party's special circumstances or
  • could have reasonably foreseen the harm, in light of the nonbreaching party's special circumstances, that would result from a breach.

Here, the firm stood to gain $1,000 per day that the drawbridge repair was completed ahead of schedule. The firm would have completed the bridge repair five days earlier but for the late delivery of the gear. Had the supplier known about those special circumstances or otherwise been able to foresee the harm that its breach would cause, consequential damages of $5,000 would be warranted. But since there is no indication the supplier knew or had reason to know of the pay provision regarding early completion, the firm will not be permitted to recover the $5,000.

(Choice A) There is no rule requiring that a party expressly agree to be responsible for consequential damages stemming from a breach to hold that party responsible.

(Choice C) When a contract calls for a specific completion date, time is considered "of the essence," and a failure to perform by that date is a breach. However, this alone is not sufficient for recovering consequential damages.

(Choice D) A party is not liable for all damages flowing directly from its breach—e.g., damages related to special circumstances of which the breaching party did not know of and could not reasonably foresee.

📌 Educational Objective

Consequential damages (i.e., losses arising from a nonbreaching party's special circumstances) are appropriate if the breaching party (1) knew about the special circumstances or (2) could have reasonably foreseen the harm, in light of the special circumstances, that would result from a breach.
questions.zh-question:
一家公司与某市政府签订了修理一座吊桥的合同，并于2月1日开始施工。合同规定，若公司在4月1日的竣工期限前完成修理，每提前一天将额外获得1000美元的报酬。3月14日，桥上一个不寻常的齿轮损坏。同日，该公司与一家供应商签订合同，要求于3月15日将唯一可用的替换齿轮运送至桥梁现场。供应商并不知道该公司的合同中包含有关提前完工的奖励性付款条款。供应商错误地派送了齿轮，导致该公司直到3月20日才收到。桥梁的修理工作于3月21日完成。然而，如果不是因为齿轮延迟交付，该公司本应在3月16日完成桥梁修理。

在对供应商提起的违约诉讼中，该公司是否可以作为其损害赔偿的一部分，追讨因供应商违约而未能从市政府获得的5000美元提前完工奖励金？

zh-choices.A: 不可以，因为供应商没有明确同意对此类损害负责。
zh-choices.B: 不可以，因为供应商不知道也没有理由知道关于提前完工的奖励性付款条款。
zh-choices.C: 可以，因为根据其与该公司合同的性质，供应商本应知道时间是合同的关键。
zh-choices.D: 可以，因为供应商应对其违约直接造成的所有损害承担责任。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Remedies - Remedies

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：供应商违约后，买方能不能把自己合同里的特殊利润损失（consequential damages）算进赔偿里。

三秒认题路径：

违约 → 间接损失 → 知情/可预见 → 不能索赔 → 选 B

核心法律规则

补偿性损害赔偿（compensatory damages）的目标，是把非违约方放回“如果合同被履行了会在哪里”的位置。先看预期损害赔偿（expectation damages），也就是违约后自然、直接会少掉的那部分。

如果损失来自对方的特殊情况（special circumstances），那就属于后果性损害赔偿（consequential damages），考场意思：只有当违约方知道这些特殊情况，或者在当时能够合理预见这种损失时，才赔。

本题里，供应商不知道也没有理由知道“提前完工每天多拿 $1,000”的激励条款，所以这 $5,000 不是它要承担的后果性损失。

核心判例： Hadley v. Baxendale — 特殊利润损失要么对方知道，要么对方当时能合理预见；否则不赔。

思维导图

先问：这笔 $5,000 是不是合同履行的“自然损失”？
不是：它来自市政合同里的提前完工奖金，属于买方自己的特殊赚钱机会。
再问：违约方当时知不知道，或能不能合理预见这个奖金？
题干事实：供应商只知道要送齿轮，不知道早完工有额外激励。
卡死点：没有 knowledge / foreseeability → 后果性损害赔偿断掉
结论：
可以赔普通修桥损失；不能把提前完工奖金（early-completion incentive pay）也一起算进去。
答案：B

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然供应商把齿轮送晚了，所有后果都该由它买单。

但考试真正问的是：这笔钱是不是供应商在违约时就能看见的风险，而不是事后回头看有多心疼。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的损失有没有发生」。 这里的关键不是“迟到导致少赚钱”，而是“对方当时知不知道这种特殊赚钱方式”。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干 supplier did not know 也没有理由知道提前完工奖金，所以这 $5,000 属于不可得的后果性损害。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把赔偿条件误成 expressly agree，其实不需要明示承担。

❌ 法律适用 | 中间上诉理由误判

✕ C: 看到 time is of the essence 就误以为能自动拿到额外奖金。

❌ 事实误判 | 题干条件偷换

✕ D: 把“直接流出”偷换成“全都要赔”，但特殊利润要先过可预见性这一关。

这题建议用什么方法？

先分清普通履约损失和后果性损失，再盯住违约方是否知道或能预见特殊获利条件。

考场速记

记住一句：后果性损害赔偿（consequential damages），先问对方知不知道你的特殊赚钱规则。

口诀：Hadley v. Baxendale = 知道 或 能预见，不然特殊利润不进赔偿表。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.topic: Remedies: Damages For Breach Of Contract
questions.question:
A contractor agreed to build a power plant for a public utility. A concrete company agreed with the contractor to lay the foundation for $200,000. The concrete company supplied goods and services worth $150,000, for which the contractor made progress payments aggregating $100,000 as required by the subcontract. The concrete company then breached by unjustifiably refusing to perform further. The contractor reasonably spent $120,000 to have the work completed by another foundation layer. The concrete company sues the contractor for the reasonable value of benefits conferred, and the contractor counterclaims for breach of contract.
Which of the following should be the court's decision?

choices.A: The concrete company recovers $50,000, the benefit conferred on the contractor for which the concrete company has not been paid.
choices.B: The concrete company recovers $30,000, the benefit the concrete company conferred on the contractor minus the $20,000 in damages incurred by the contractor.
choices.C: The contractor recovers $20,000, the excess over the contract price that was paid by the contractor for the performance it had bargained to receive from the concrete company.
choices.D: Neither party recovers anything, because the concrete company committed a material, unexcused breach and the contractor received a $50,000 benefit from the concrete company for which the concrete company has not been paid.

questions.explanation:
Compensatory damages for breach of construction contracts
Before construction starts During construction After construction completed
Breach by builder (owner paid) Owner entitled to cost of completion Owner entitled to:
  • cost of completion/correction if no undue economic waste OR
  • value of promised construction minus nonconforming construction
 N/A
Breach by owner (did not pay) Builder entitled to:
  • lost profits plus costs incurred OR
  • contract price minus cost of completion
 Builder entitled to contract price

Breach of a construction contract allows the nonbreaching party to seek compensatory damages that will place that party in the same position as if the contract had been performed. When the breaching party is the builder (as seen here) and the breach occurs during construction, the nonbreaching party can generally recover the cost of completion over the contract price.* But the builder can only recover the value of unpaid-for work performed before the breach if the nonbreaching party was unjustly enriched by that work.

Here, the concrete company breached the construction contract by refusing to complete the foundation as agreed. At that time, the contractor had already paid the company $100,000. The contractor then spent $120,000 to have the work completed by another foundation layer—bringing the contractor's total payment to $220,000. Since the contract price was $200,000, the contractor should recover the $20,000 cost of completion over the contract price (Choice D).

*When the cost of completion over the contract price is clearly excessive compared to the loss in value caused by the breach (ie, involves undue economic waste), recovery is instead based on the value of the promised construction minus the value of the nonconforming construction.

(Choices A & B) Although the concrete company provided the contractor $50,000 worth of goods and services for which it has not been paid, the contractor was not unjustly enriched—ie, did not receive a benefit that was not rightfully earned and would be unfair to keep. The reason is that the contractor still had to pay $20,000 in excess of the contract price, so any payment to the concrete company would just make the contractor's damages worse.

📌 Educational Objective

When a builder breaches a construction contract during construction, the nonbreaching party can recover the cost of completion over the contract price.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 348 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that the measure of damages for defective construction is the cost of completion unless it is clearly disproportionate to the loss in value).
questions.zh-question:
一个承包商同意为一家公共事业公司建造一座发电厂。一家混凝土公司与该承包商达成协议，以20万美元的价格铺设地基。该混凝土公司提供了价值15万美元的货物和服务，承包商根据分包合同的要求，累计支付了10万美元的进度款。随后，该混凝土公司无正当理由地拒绝继续履行合同，构成了违约。该承包商合理地花费了12万美元，请另一家地基铺设公司完成了这项工作。该混凝土公司就其所赋予利益的合理价值起诉承包商，而承包商则以违约为由提起反诉。

以下哪项应当是法院的判决？

zh-choices.A: 混凝土公司获赔5万美元，这是其赋予承包商但尚未获得报酬的利益。
zh-choices.B: 混凝土公司获赔3万美元，这是其赋予承包商的利益减去承包商所遭受的2万美元损害赔偿金。
zh-choices.C: 承包商获赔2万美元，这是承包商为获得其与混凝土公司协商的履约而支付的超出合同价格的费用。
zh-choices.D: 任何一方均无所获，因为混凝土公司构成了实质性且无正当理由的违约，而承包商从混凝土公司获得了价值5万美元但尚未支付的利益。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Remedies - Remedies: Damages For Breach Of Contract

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：建筑分包在施工中被承包方违约时，完工成本超出合同价（cost of completion over contract price）怎么赔，通常不是按“已提供价值”单独算。

三秒认题路径：

施工中违约 → 施工方违约 → 先看完工成本 → 超过合同价 → 选 C

核心法律规则

建设合同（construction contract）里，如果是承包方/施工方（builder）在施工过程中先违约，非违约方一般拿补偿性损害赔偿（compensatory damages），目标是把他放回“合同按约履行后”的位置。

这题里，关键规则是：非违约方通常可主张完工成本（cost of completion），再和合同价（contract price）比较；如果为补完工程多花的钱合理，差额就是赔偿。

只有当完工成本明显过高、会造成经济浪费（economic waste）时，才改看diminution in value，也就是“承诺建成的价值 - 实际瑕疵价值”。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 348 - 说明建筑瑕疵通常按完工成本赔，除非明显失衡。

思维导图

合同签订
分包价 $200,000，先看双方约定的基准价。
施工中
施工方中途拒绝继续 → 这是builder breach，不是完工后争议。
补完工程
另请他人花 $120,000，把总支出推到 $220,000。
结论
超出合同价 $20,000，这就是非违约方的赔偿起点。
题干先问：谁先违约？
是施工方先违约 → 进入完工成本规则。
已付 $100,000，但还要再花 $120,000 才能拿到本来应得的工程。
卡死点：不是看施工方“做了多少价值”，而是看承包方为了拿到约定成果多花了多少钱。
结果 → 赔 $20,000，对应正确选项。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：施工方已经交付了 $150,000 的货物和服务，没付的部分好像该按“受益”补给它。

但考试真正问的是：承包方为了拿回自己本来要的工程，最后有没有被迫多掏钱；这里多掏的 $20,000 才是核心。

司法考试看的是「合同程序上谁该承担补完工程的额外成本」，而不是「物理上到底留下了多少已完成价值」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干的关键事实是：施工方在施工中违约，承包方为补完工程总共花到 $220,000，比合同价多 $20,000，所以应赔这笔差额。

❌ 概念混淆 | 已付价值误判

✕ A: 只盯着 benefit conferred，忘了对方已被迫多付补完成本。

❌ 事实误判 | 减赔偷换

✕ B: 把 $50,000 当成可直接抵扣的损失，题干没有这个扣减逻辑。

❌ 法律适用 | 不当富裕误套

✕ D: 看到 material breach 就想全盘归零，但建筑违约赔法不是这么算。

这题建议用什么方法？

先锁定是“施工中 builder breach”，再直接算补完工程是否高过合同价。

考场速记

记住这句：施工方施工中违约，先算补完工程；多出来的钱，就是常见赔偿。

这类题看到 construction contract，先问“谁违约、什么时候违约、补完要多花多少”，不要先被“已交付价值”带跑。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A mother whose adult son was a law school graduate contracted with a tutor to give the son a bar exam preparation course. "If my son passes the bar exam," the mother explained to the tutor, "he has been promised a job with a law firm that will pay $55,000 a year." The tutor agreed to do the work for $5,000, although the going rate was $6,000.
Before the instruction was to begin and before any payment was made, the tutor repudiated the contract. Although the mother or the son reasonably could have employed, for $6,000, an equally qualified instructor to replace the tutor, neither did so. The son failed the bar exam, and the law firm refused to employ him. It can be shown that had the son received the tutor's instruction, he would have passed the bar exam.
If the mother and the son join as plaintiffs and sue the tutor for breach of contract, how much, if anything, are they entitled to recover?

choices.A: $1,000, because all other damages could have been avoided by employing another equally qualified instructor.
choices.B: $55,000, because damages of that amount were within the contemplation of the parties at the time they contracted.
choices.C: Nominal damages only, because the mother was not injured by the breach and the tutor made no promise to the son.
choices.D: Nothing, because neither the mother nor the son took steps to avoid the consequences of the tutor's breach.

questions.explanation:
Expectation (ie, benefit-of-the-bargain) damages
Definition
  • Losses arising naturally & obviously from breach
Purpose
  • Place nonbreaching party in same position as if contract had been performed
Measure
  • General rule – difference between contract price & market price (or cost of purchasing substitute performance)
  • Construction contracts – difference between contract price & cost of construction by another builder

The primary goal of contract damages is to place the nonbreaching party in the same position as if the contract had been fully performed. This typically means that the nonbreaching party can recover:

  • consequential damages – losses arising from the nonbreaching party's special circumstances that the breaching party could reasonably foresee when the contract was made and/or
  • expectation damages – losses arising naturally and obviously from the breach, which can be measured by the difference between the contract price and the market price.

However, damages that could have been mitigated (i.e., avoided or minimized) through reasonable efforts are not recoverable.*

Here, the tutor repudiated the contract prior to performing. Although it was foreseeable that the son would lose his job offer if he failed the bar exam, that loss could have been avoided by employing an equally qualified instructor for $6,000. As a result, the mother and son cannot claim $55,000 in consequential damages for the son's lost salary (Choice B). However, this does not prevent them from recovering the difference between the $5,000 contract price and the $6,000 market price—a total of $1,000 in expectation damages.

*The nonbreaching party will not be precluded from recovery to the extent that the nonbreaching party has made reasonable but unsuccessful efforts to avoid loss.

(Choice C) Although the tutor made no promise to the son, the mother-tutor contract was made to benefit the son (the one who would be receiving tutoring). This means that the son was an intended third-party beneficiary of the contract. As a result, both the mother and the son were entitled to sue for damages. In addition, they can recover $1,000 in expectation damages—not merely nominal damages.

(Choice D) The tutor breached the contract to help the son on the bar exam for $5,000. However, the mother cannot recover the full $5,000 because she failed to take reasonable steps to mitigate those damages. As a result, her recovery is limited to the difference between the contract price ($5,000) and the market price for another tutor ($6,000)—for a recovery of only $1,000.**

**Had the market price been less than the contract price, then the mother would recover nothing.

📌 Educational Objective

The nonbreaching party cannot recover damages for losses that could have been mitigated (i.e., avoided or minimized) through reasonable efforts.
questions.zh-question:
一位母亲，其成年儿子是法学院毕业生，与一名辅导老师签订合同，为儿子提供律师资格考试辅导课程。“如果我儿子通过律师资格考试，”母亲向辅导老师解释说，“他已经得到一家律师事务所的承诺，将获得一份年薪55,000美元的工作。”辅导老师同意以5,000美元的价格提供服务，尽管市场价是6,000美元。

在辅导开始前且任何款项支付前，该辅导老师拒绝履行合同。尽管母亲或儿子本可以合理地以6,000美元的价格聘请另一位同样合格的老师来代替该辅导老师，但他们都没有这样做。儿子未能通过律师资格考试，该律师事务所也拒绝聘用他。有证据表明，如果儿子接受了该辅导老师的辅导，他本可以（或将会）通过律师资格考试。

如果母亲和儿子作为共同原告，因违约而起诉该辅导老师，他们有权获得多少赔偿（如果有的话）？

zh-choices.A: 1,000美元，因为所有其他损失本可以通过聘请另一位同样合格的老师来避免。
zh-choices.B: 55,000美元，因为在双方签订合同时，该数额的损失是在双方可预见范围之内的。
zh-choices.C: 仅象征性损害赔偿，因为母亲没有因违约而受到损害，且辅导老师没有对儿子做出任何承诺。
zh-choices.D: 无赔偿，因为母亲和儿子都没有采取措施来避免因辅导老师违约造成的后果。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Remedies - Avoidable consequences & mitigation

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：合同违约后，非违约方能拿多少赔偿，关键先看有没有尽合理努力减损（mitigation），再看还能不能拿替代履行的预期利益损害赔偿。

三秒认题路径：

先问减损 → 再算替代 → 只赔差额 → 不能躺赔 → 选 $1,000

核心法律规则

合同救济的目标，是把非违约方放回如果合同被履行时的状态；这类 预期利益损害赔偿（expectation damages），考场意思：让你拿到“本来应得的交易好处”。

但 减损义务（duty to mitigate），考场意思：你不能眼看损失扩大却什么都不做；能用合理办法避免或缩小的部分，通常不能再向违约方索赔。

所以本题里，母亲和儿子最多只能拿替代老师的差额：$5,000 合同价（contract price） 与 $6,000 市价（market price） 之间的 $1,000；那笔 $55,000 薪资损失（consequential damages） 虽然可预见，但本来能靠找替代老师避免掉。

核心判例： 这里锁定的是减损规则本身；考试记住，能合理替代、能把损失压住的部分，不能转成被告要赔的全部连锁损失。

思维导图

违约后先看：能不能用合理办法把损失压住？
有 题干已说：另找同等合格老师 只要 $6,000，而且母亲/儿子都没去找。
卡死点：可避免的 consequential damages 不赔，不能把 $55,000 工资损失全甩给违约方。
剩下能赔 只剩 替代履行差额：$6,000 市价 − $5,000 合同价 = $1,000。
结论 选 A：不是全赔丢掉的工作，而是只赔本来就不可避免的差额。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然老师先毁约，而且儿子确实因为没过 bar 才丢工作，那就应该把 $55,000 一起赔出来。

但考试真正问的是：这笔损失当时虽然 可预见（foreseeable），却本来能用合理替代老师直接避开，所以不能全部转嫁给违约方。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干已给出 同等合格老师只要 $6,000，所以真正可赔的是替代履行差额 $1,000，而不是可避免的后续工资损失。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ B: 把 foreseeable 当成“全赔”了。

❌ 法律适用 | 主体资格误判

✕ C: 抓着 no promise 不放，漏掉了第三人受益人可以起诉。

❌ 事实误判 | 减损条件偷换

✕ D: 说成“完全没损失”，但题干明明还有 $1,000 的差额可赔。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓减损，再算替代履行差额；凡是本来能用合理行动避免的连锁损失，先砍掉。

考场速记

记忆口诀：先减损，再算差额；能合理避免的损失，不要拿违约方当“无限赔偿池”。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A sailor owns a boat that she charters for sport fishing at a $500 daily rate. The fee includes the use of the boat with the sailor as the captain, and one other crew member, as well as fishing tackle and bait. On May 1, a customer agreed with the sailor that the customer would have the full-day use of the boat on May 15 for himself and his family for $500. The customer paid an advance deposit of $200 and signed an agreement that the deposit could be retained by the sailor as liquidated damages in the event the customer canceled or failed to appear. At the time of contracting, the sailor told the customer to be at the dock at 5:00 a.m. on May 15. The customer and his family, however, did not show up on May 15 until noon. In the meantime, the sailor agreed at 10:00 a.m. to take a third party and her family out fishing for the rest of the day. The third party had happened to come by and inquire about the possibility of such an outing. In view of the late hour, the sailor charged the third party $400 and stayed out two hours beyond the customary return time. The customer's failure to appear until noon was due to the fact that he had been trying to charter another boat across the bay at a lower rate and had gotten lost after he was unsuccessful in getting such a charter.
Which of the following is an accurate statement concerning the legal obligations of the parties?

choices.A: The sailor can retain the $200 paid by the customer, because it would be difficult for the sailor to establish her actual damages and the sum appears to have been a reasonable forecast in light of anticipated loss of profit from the charter.
choices.B: The sailor is entitled to retain only $50 (10% of the contract price) and must return $150 to the customer.
choices.C: The sailor must return $100 to the customer, because the liquidated-damage clause under the circumstances would operate as a penalty.
choices.D: The sailor must return $100 to the customer in order to avoid her own unjust enrichment at the customer's expense.

questions.explanation:
Purpose of compensatory damages
Primary (expectation measure)
  • Place nonbreaching party in same position as if contract had been performed
  • Expectation measure includes:
    • Expectation damages
    • Incidental damages
    • Consequential damages
Fallback (reliance measure)
  • When expectation measure too speculative, place nonbreaching party in same position as if no contract had been formed
  • Reliance measure includes:
    • Reliance damages
    • Liquidated damages
    • Restitution

To recover damages, a party must prove the dollar amount of the damages with reasonable certainty. Where it would be difficult to establish actual damages, the parties may agree to liquidated damages—i.e., a fixed measure of damages for breach set forth in the contract. However, a liquidated-damages clause is unenforceable as a penalty if the amount is so unreasonably large in relation to actual or anticipated damages that it punishes the breaching party (as opposed to merely compensating the nonbreaching party).

Here, the customer contracted to use the sailor's boat for a full day for $500. The customer paid a $200 deposit, which the sailor could retain as liquidated damages if the customer canceled or failed to appear. Although the sailor ultimately collected $600 for the day ($200 retained deposit + $400 from the third party), she also stayed out two hours later than the customary return time as a result of the customer's breach. As a result, the $200 appears to have been a reasonable measure of damages, and the sailor can retain the full amount (Choice C).

(Choice B) There is no rule that, if applied, would result in the sailor retaining $50 (10% of the contract price).

(Choice D) Restitutionary damages ensure that the nonbreaching party (here, the sailor) is not unjustly enriched—i.e., does not receive a benefit that was not rightfully earned and would be unfair to keep. But here, the parties agreed to the deposit as a reasonable amount of damages in the event of the customer's breach.

📌 Educational Objective

A liquidated-damages clause is unenforceable as a penalty if the amount is so unreasonably large in relation to actual or anticipated damages that it punishes the breaching party.

一名船主拥有一艘船，她以每日500美元的价格出租用于运动海钓。该费用包括船只的使用、船主担任船长、另一名船员，以及渔具和鱼饵。5月1日，一位顾客与船主约定，该顾客及其家人将于5月15日以500美元的价格全天使用该船。顾客支付了200美元的预付定金，并签署了一份协议，约定如果顾客取消或未能出现，船主可以保留该定金作为违约金。在签订合同时，船主告知顾客应于5月15日早上5点到达码头。然而，该顾客及其家人直到5月15日中午才出现。在此期间，船主于上午10点同意带第三方及其家人出海钓鱼度过当天余下的时间。该第三方是碰巧过来询问是否有此种出游的可能性。考虑到时间已晚，船主向该第三方收取了400美元，并且比通常的返航时间晚了两个小时。顾客直到中午才出现，是因为他试图在海湾对面以更低的价格租用另一艘船，但在未能租到船后迷路了。

以下哪项是关于双方当事人法律义务的准确陈述？

zh-choices.A: 船主可以保留顾客支付的200美元，因为船主难以确定其实际损失，并且鉴于租船业务的预期利润损失，这笔金额似乎是一个合理的预估。
zh-choices.B: 船主仅有权保留50美元（合同价格的10%），并且必须向顾客退还150美元。
zh-choices.C: 船主必须向顾客退还100美元，因为在这种情况下，违约金条款将构成一种惩罚。
zh-choices.D: 船主必须向顾客退还100美元，以避免因顾客的损失而获得不当得利。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Remedies - Remedies

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：约定的违约金（liquidated damages）能不能保住，关键看它是不是对可预期损失的合理估算，而不是惩罚。

三秒认题路径：

先看损失难算 → 再看预估合理 → 不是惩罚 → 可保留定金 → 选 A

核心法律规则

液化违约金（liquidated damages）在考场上的意思是：双方先把违约时该赔多少钱写死，省得事后吵实际损失。前提是当时实际损失（actual damages）不好算，而且金额要像对损失的合理预估。

如果这笔钱大到明显超过可能损失，考试就会把它当成罚金（penalty），结果是条款无效，不能照收。这里船主原本很难精确算出空档期损失，$200 看起来也只是对一天包船利润的合理预估，不是在惩罚顾客。

核心判例： liquidated damages 规则锁定：合理预估（reasonable forecast）可以留，罚金（penalty）不行。

思维导图

1. 先看损失难不难算
包船爽约后的空档损失，不容易用精确数字证明。
2. 再看定额是否合理
$200 占 $500 合同价的比例不夸张，更像预估赔偿。
3. 排除惩罚性目的
条款是为了补偿空档损失，不是为了吓罚违约方。
4. 结论
可保留 $200，所以正确答案是 A。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然只收了 deposit，那是不是就要按“只能留一小部分”或者“必须返还多出来的钱”来算。

但考试真正问的是：这个定额是不是对当时可预见损失的合理估算，而不是看它后来有没有刚好匹配实际收款。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，不是「表面上谁最后多收了多少钱」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干 200 美元定金是为弥补爽约后的空档损失，且损失难精算，所以看起来是合理预估，不是罚金。

❌ 概念混淆 | 10%比例误判

✕ B: 把 10% 当成固定法则，题里根本没有这种计算。

❌ 法律适用 | 罚金认定误搬

✕ C: 看到 penalty 就直接套错，本题金额并不离谱。

❌ 事实误判 | 不当得利偷换

✕ D: 把 unjust enrichment 硬拉进来，但双方已先约好定金用途。

这题建议用什么方法？

先问损失是否难证，再问定额是不是合理预估；只要不是惩罚，定金就能留。

考场速记

记住一句话：违约金条款（liquidated damages clause）能不能站住，就看它是不是对难算损失的合理预估（reasonable forecast）；太狠、太离谱、像惩罚，就会被打掉。

reason.en: Specifies the contract remedy in the event of breach.
reason.zh: 规定了违约情况下的合同救济方式。

reason.en: Identifies the specific amount set aside as damages.

A.text: difficult for the sailor to establish her actual damages

reason.en: Requirement that actual damages be hard to estimate at contracting.
reason.zh: 要求在订立合同时实际损失难以估算。

reason.en: Requirement that the liquidated sum be a reasonable estimate of anticipated loss.
reason.zh: 要求约定违约金数额是对预期损失的合理估算。

reason.en: Suggests a non-existent rule limiting recovery to a fixed percentage.

reason.en: Tests whether the amount is an unenforceable punishment rather than a valid forecast.

highlights.text: deposit could be retained by the sailor as liquidated damages

reason.en: Specifies the remedy agreed upon by the parties.
reason.zh: 明示了当事人双方约定的救济方式。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A person who knew nothing about horses inherited a thoroughbred colt whose disagreeable behavior made him a pest around the barn. The person sold the colt for $1,500 to a buyer who was an experienced racehorse-trainer and knew of the person's ignorance about horses. At the time of sale, the person said to the buyer, "I hate to say it, but this horse is bad-tempered and nothing special." Soon after the sale, the colt won three races and earned $400,000 for the buyer.
Which of the following additional facts, if established by the person, would best support his chance of obtaining rescission of the sale to the buyer?

choices.A: At a pre-sale exercise session of which the buyer knew that the person was not aware, the buyer clocked the colt in record-setting time, far surpassing any previous performance.
choices.B: At the time of the sale, the person was angry and upset over an incident in which the colt had reared and thrown a rider.
choices.C: The colt was the only thoroughbred that the person owned, and the person did not know how to evaluate young and untested racehorses.
choices.D: The person did not know until after the sale that the buyer was an experienced racehorse-trainer.

questions.explanation:
Mistake as grounds for rescission
Mutual
mistake

Adversely affected party can rescind contract if:

  • mistake relates to basic assumption of contract
  • mistake materially affects agreed-upon exchange of performances

AND

  • adversely affected party did not assume risk of mistake
Unilateral
mistake

In addition to above elements for mutual mistake, either:

  • mistake makes enforcement of contract unconscionable

OR

  • nonmistaken party caused, or knew or should have known of, mistake

Rescission is a remedy that allows the court to cancel a contract and discharge the parties' contractual obligations. This remedy is available to a party who entered into a contract based on a unilateral mistake if:

  • the mistake relates to a basic assumption of the contract (eg, the person thought the colt was "nothing special" and so agreed to sell it for $1,500)
  • the mistake materially affects the agreed-upon exchange of performances (eg, the colt was actually worth much more, as evidenced by its winning three races and earning $400,000)
  • the adversely affected party did not assume the risk of the mistake (eg, the person knew nothing about horses)
    AND
  • either (1) the mistake would make enforcement of the contract unconscionable or (2) the nonmistaken party caused, or knew or had reason to know of, the mistake.

Therefore, the fact that the buyer had clocked the colt in record-setting time at a pre-sale exercise session, of which the buyer knew that the person was not aware, would best support the person's chance of obtaining rescission.

(Choices B, C & D) None of these additional facts show that (1) enforcement of the sale would be unconscionable or (2) the buyer (nonmistaken party) caused, or knew or had reason to know of, the person's mistake. As a result, these facts do not support the person's chance of obtaining rescission of the sale to the buyer.

📌 Educational Objective

A party's unilateral mistake is grounds for rescission only if (1) the mistake would make enforcement of the contract unconscionable or (2) the nonmistaken party caused, or knew or had reason to know of, the mistake.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 153 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (unilateral mistake making contract voidable).
questions.zh-question:
一个对马一无所知的人继承了一匹纯种小公马，这匹马的性情令人讨厌，在马厩里是个麻烦精。此人以1500美元的价格将这匹小公马卖给了一位买家，该买家是一位经验丰富的赛马训练师，并且知道此人对马一无所知。在出售时，此人对买家说：“我不想这么说，但这匹马脾气不好，没什么特别之处。”出售后不久，这匹小公马赢得了三场比赛，为买家赚取了40万美元。

如果以下哪个额外事实由此人证实，将最有力地支持他获得撤销与买家之间交易的机会？

zh-choices.A: 在一次售前训练中，买家测得这匹小公马的成绩创下纪录，远超以往任何表现，而买家知道此人对此并不知情。
zh-choices.B: 在出售时，此人正因小公马曾扬蹄将骑手摔下的事件而生气和沮丧。
zh-choices.C: 这匹小公马是此人拥有的唯一一匹纯种马，且此人不知道如何评估年幼未经测试的赛马。
zh-choices.D: 此人直到出售后才知道买家是一位经验丰富的赛马训练师。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Remedies - Defenses to Enforcement

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：单方错误（unilateral mistake）能不能成为合同解除（rescission）的理由。

三秒认题路径：

单方错误 → 基础假设 → 重大影响 → 未承担风险 → 可解除

核心法律规则

一眼能用的规则

如果一方因单方错误（unilateral mistake）签约，法院只有在两条路之一成立时才可能给解除（rescission）：要么继续履行会显失公平（unconscionable），要么无错误的一方造成了错误，或者知道、应当知道这个错误。

前提还要满足：错误碰到的是合同的基础假设（basic assumption），并且它确实改写了双方交换的价值；考场上你要盯的不是“卖家心情好不好”，而是“买家是不是早就知道真实价值”。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 153 — 这条规则锁定：单方错误不是自动撤销，必须再过“显失公平”或“对方知情”这道门。

思维导图

看到“卖错马”先问：这是不是单方错误想要解除？
先看前提：卖家以为马“nothing special”，但后来证明这匹马能赢比赛、价值暴涨，说明错误打到的是基础假设（basic assumption）。
再看第二层：卖家不懂马，不等于自动赢；还要看对方是不是知道或应当知道（knew or should have known）这个错误，或者履行会不会显失公平（unconscionable）。
卡死点：A 选项里，买家在卖家不知情的预赛中跑出破纪录成绩，且买家知道卖家没看到，这就直接指向“对方知道错误”。
所以结论：能支持解除的不是“马后来很值钱”本身，而是买家隐瞒了卖家不知道的关键表现。
答案落点：选 A。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然这匹马后来赚了四十万美元，那卖家显然被坑惨了，应该能撤销。

但考试真正问的是：买家有没有掌握卖家不知道的关键事实，或者交易继续履行会不会到“不能接受”的程度。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

所以“后来涨价很多”只是背景，不是自动通关；真正能救人的，是买家在卖前已经知道这匹马的真实表现，却让卖家在信息盲区里定价。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

买家在卖家不知情时看过破纪录的预赛表现，还知道卖家没看到，这正好支持“对方知道错误”，最能帮卖家拿到解除。

❌ 概念混淆 | 情绪事实误判

✕ B: 只是卖家当时生气，不是买家知道秘密。

❌ 事实误判 | 交易信息偷换

✕ C: 只说明他不懂马，没碰到买家的知情行为。

❌ 法律适用 | 事后知情误套

✕ D: 事后才知道买家身份，来不及证明卖前错误被利用。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓“对方是否知情”这条门槛，再看“卖方是否承担风险”，不要被后来暴赚的结果带偏。

考场速记

记忆口诀：单方错误想撤销，先看对方知不知；不知就再问显失公平。

这题的抓手是：卖前关键事实，不是卖后结果。看到“我不知道”“对方知道”“卖前偷偷测过”这类词，就优先往解除（rescission）方向想。

question_analysis.skill_tested: identifying grounds for contract rescission

reason.en: Establishes the seller's basic assumption mistake regarding the horse's characteristics.
reason.zh: 确立出卖人关于马匹特征的基本假设认识错误。

reason.en: Indicates the buyer's professional status and capacity to evaluate the horse.
reason.zh: 表明买受人的专业身份以及评估马匹的能力。

reason.en: Shows that one party was mistaken about a material fact.
reason.zh: 表明其中一方对实质性事实存在错误认识。

reason.en: The remedy sought by the seller to undo the transaction.
reason.zh: 出卖人寻求撤销交易的救济方式。

A.text: buyer knew that the person was not aware

reason.en: Shows the buyer had reason to know of the seller's mistake, supporting rescission.
reason.zh: 表明买受人有理由知晓出卖人的错误，从而支持合同撤销。

reason.en: Emotional distress or anger does not invalidate consent or justify rescission.
reason.zh: 情绪波动或愤怒不能使同意无效，也不构成撤销的理由。

C.text: did not know how to evaluate

reason.en: General lack of skill does not support rescission without buyer's knowledge of a specific mistake.
reason.zh: 如果买受人不知晓特定错误，仅凭缺乏专业技能不支持撤销。

D.text: did not know until after the sale

label.zh: 对买受人身份的不知情

reason.en: Unawareness of the buyer's professional identity does not establish unilateral mistake regarding the horse itself.
reason.zh: 不知晓买受人的专业身份，并不构成对马匹本身单方误解的成立要件。

highlights.text: knew of the person's ignorance about horses

label.zh: 相对人知晓对方的认识错误

reason.en: Crucial element for unilateral mistake; the other party knew or had reason to know of the mistake.
reason.zh: 单方认识错误的关键要件；相对人知晓或有理由知晓该认识错误。

highlights.text: obtaining rescission of the sale

reason.en: Identifies the core legal issue: establishing grounds to rescind the transaction.
reason.zh: 确定核心法律争议：建立撤销交易的基础。

highlights.text: sold the colt for $1,500

reason.en: Highlights the contract price, illustrating the impact of the mistake.
reason.zh: 突出了合同价格，说明认识错误所造成的影响。

questions.subject: Contracts
questions.question:
A construction company contracted with a regional distributor to construct a warehouse and an access driveway at highway level for $500,000. Shortly after commencing work on the driveway, the construction company unexpectedly encountered a large mass of solid rock. Instead of incurring additional costs to remove the rock formation, the construction company built the access driveway over the rock with a steep grade down to the highway.
The distributor, who was out of town for several days, was unaware of this nonconformity until the driveway had been finished. As built, it is too steep to be used safely by trucks or cars, particularly in the wet or icy weather frequently occurring in the area. It would cost $30,000 to tear out and rebuild the driveway at highway level. As built, the warehouse, including the driveway, has a fair market value of $550,000. The distributor has paid $470,000 to the construction company, but refuses to pay more because of the nonconforming driveway, which the construction company has refused to tear out and rebuild.
If the construction company sues the distributor for monetary relief, what is the maximum amount the construction company is entitled to recover?

choices.A: $30,000, because the construction company substantially performed and the cost of correcting the driveway would involve economic waste.
choices.B: $30,000, because the fair market value of the warehouse and driveway "as is" exceeds the contract price by $50,000 (more than the cost of correcting the driveway).
choices.C: $30,000, minus whatever amount the construction company saved by not building the driveway at the specified level.
choices.D: Nothing, because the distributor is entitled to damages for the cost of correcting the driveway.

questions.explanation:
Compensatory damages for breach of construction contracts
Before construction starts During construction After construction completed
Breach by builder (owner paid) Owner entitled to cost of completion Owner entitled to:
  • cost of completion/correction if no undue economic waste OR
  • value of promised construction minus nonconforming construction
 N/A
Breach by owner (did not pay) Builder entitled to:
  • lost profits plus costs incurred OR
  • contract price minus cost of completion
 Builder entitled to contract price

When a contract is breached, the nonbreaching party is entitled to recover compensatory damages. Compensatory damages can arise, for example, when a builder breaches a contract during construction (ie, nonconforming construction). In that case, the owner's damages are the cost of completing or correcting the nonconforming construction, provided that this would not involve any undue economic waste. One way to recover these damages is to deduct them from the contract price owed by the owner.

Here, the $500,000 contract called for the construction of a driveway at highway level. The construction company breached that contract by building the driveway over a rock mass with a steep grade that makes the driveway unsafe. The $30,000 cost to correct the driveway is not unduly wasteful since this expense is necessary to safely access the warehouse (Choice A). And since the distributor was entitled to deduct that amount from the contract price and pay no more than $470,000, the construction company can recover nothing.

(Choice B) Compensatory damages attempt to put the nonbreaching party (eg, the distributor) in the same position as if the contract had been performed as promised. Therefore, the distributor was entitled to deduct his damages for the nonconforming driveway even though the value of the warehouse exceeds the contract price by a greater amount than the cost of correcting the driveway.

(Choice C) If the owner breaches a construction contract prior to completion, the builder is entitled to recover the contract price minus whatever amount the builder saved by not having to complete the construction (ie, the cost of completion). But here, since the builder (ie, the construction company) breached, it is not entitled to recover any amount, and it is irrelevant how much was saved by not building the driveway at the specified level.

📌 Educational Objective

If a builder breaches a contract during construction, the owner can recover the cost of completing or correcting the construction if it involves no undue economic waste.

📚 References
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 348 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that the measure of damages for defective construction is the cost of completion as long as it is not clearly disproportionate to the loss in value).
questions.zh-question:
一家建筑公司与一家区域分销商签订合同，以50万美元的价格建造一个仓库和一条与公路路面齐平的入口车道 (access driveway)。在入口车道 (access driveway) 工程开工后不久，建筑公司意外地遇到了一大块坚固的岩石。建筑公司没有为移除岩石层而产生额外费用，而是在岩石上修建了入口车道 (access driveway)，形成了一个通往高速公路的陡坡。

分销商因出城数日，直到车道完工后才发现这一不符合同规定之处。建成后的车道坡度过陡，卡车或汽车无法安全使用，尤其是在该地区经常出现的潮湿或结冰天气下。拆除车道并重建至与公路齐平的水平将花费3万美元。建成后，包括车道在内的仓库的公平市场价值为55万美元。分销商已向建筑公司支付了47万美元，但因车道不符合同规定而拒绝支付更多款项，而建筑公司也拒绝拆除和重建该车道。

如果建筑公司就金钱救济起诉分销商，建筑公司有权获得的最高金额是多少？

zh-choices.A: 3万美元，因为建筑公司已实质性履行合同，且修正车道的成本会造成经济浪费。
zh-choices.B: 3万美元，因为仓库和车道“按现状”的公平市场价值比合同价格高出5万美元（超过了修正车道的成本）。
zh-choices.C: 3万美元，减去建筑公司因未按规定水平建造车道而节省的任何金额。
zh-choices.D: 无，因为分销商有权就修正车道的成本获得损害赔偿。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Remedies - Remedies

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：承包人施工中违约并造成不符合合同约定的施工（nonconforming construction）时，业主能否扣减修复/完成成本（cost of completion/correction），从而把承包人的索赔压到零。

三秒认题路径：

施工中违约 → 业主已付款 → 修复成本 → 无过度浪费 → 扣减到零

核心法律规则

建筑合同里，若承包人在施工中交付的是瑕疵工程（defective performance），违约方的对方通常可以拿完成或修复成本（cost of completion or correction）作为补偿性损害赔偿；考场意思：只要这笔钱不是明显economic waste，就能用来抵扣对价。

如果修复能把工程改回合同承诺的位置，法考就看修复能否真正恢复预期利益，不是看业主最后是不是“看起来还值钱”。市场价值（fair market value）高于合同价，不会自动抹掉修复赔偿。

本题里，车道做成了危险的大坡度，$30,000 的重建可以直接把高速水平（highway level）车道修回来，属于可扣减的补偿性损害。

核心判例： Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 348 - 对缺陷施工，若修复成本不过分高于价值损失，就按修复成本算。

思维导图

承包人在施工中做出不符合合同的车道，业主想用什么金额抵扣？
先看：这是建筑施工违约（breach during construction），不是业主拒付。
规则：业主可主张修复成本（cost of correction），前提是修复不构成undue economic waste。
本题事实：车道太陡，卡车和汽车在湿滑天气下都不安全，$30,000 就能拆掉重建到合同位置。
杀伤点：不是看整栋仓库“市值更高”，而是看这笔修复钱能不能把业主放回合同应有状态。
结论：业主可扣减 $30,000，承包人向业主再索赔时，最大回收额 = 0。
误区：把“工程最后总价值”当成唯一标准，或把承包人省下的成本拿来算收益。
这题不走“承包人省了多少”路线，因为违约的是承包人，不是业主。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然建成后的仓库加车道市值还有 $550,000，似乎承包人还能拿到一部分钱。

但考试真正问的是：业主能不能用修复成本（cost of correction）先把应付价款扣下来；这里答案是能，所以承包人最后拿不到额外金额。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的瑕疵看起来有没有被市场价值掩盖」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干 $30,000 修复为安全车道，属于业主可扣减的补偿性损害；分包方已违约，所以承包人向业主追钱的最大额就是 0。

❌ 概念混淆 | 经济浪费误判

✕ A: 把 economic waste 当成挡箭牌，但这题修复是为了安全通行。

❌ 法律适用 | 市值抵扣误判

✕ B: 误把“成品市值更高”当成承包人可收钱的理由。

❌ 事实误判 | 节省成本误算

✕ C: 把 saved by not 的思路硬套到违约方身上。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓谁违约、谁能扣减，再看修复成本有没有被“过度浪费”挡住。

考场速记

建筑合同施工中违约，先问业主能不能拿修复/完成成本抵扣；能修回合同状态且不构成economic waste 时，承包人通常拿不到额外价款。记忆口诀：“修得回，就能扣；修不回，才看替代价值”。
